name: @eduignite/capacitor-apk-installer
description: Native-only local Capacitor plugin: hands a downloaded APK to the Android system package installer. Installed by apps/mobile and apps/offline-companion purely so `cap sync` discovers and links the android/ native module below -- there is deliberately no JS entry point here (see each app's own src/lib/apk-installer.ts for the registerPlugin() call and the shared download helper). A JS file living at this package's real (symlinked-from) path can't resolve @capacitor/core or @capacitor/filesystem, since those only exist inside each app's own node_modules, not this package's -- moving that glue into each app avoids the problem entirely instead of fighting module resolution across a non-workspace monorepo.
